feature: Enhance keyboard accessibility for modal dialogs
workflow_rationale: This is a refactor workflow because we're improving existing modal functionality by adding accessibility features. We'll add the new accessible modal system alongside the current implementation, migrate existing modals incrementally, and ensure no functionality breaks during the transition.

phases.name: Add Accessible Modal System
phases.description: Create new Alpine.js accessible modal component with focus trapping, focus restoration, and ARIA attributes

subtasks.description: Create accessible modal Alpine.js helper with focus management
implementation_notes: Extend existing Alpine.data('modal') helper in app.js
Add focusTrap functionality - track first and last focusable elements
Add focus restoration - store reference to trigger element on open
Implement Tab/Shift+Tab cycling between first and last elements
Add proper ARIA attributes management (aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby)
Maintain backward compatibility with existing modal() helper

verification.instructions: 1. Open browser console, 2. Check that Alpine.data('accessibleModal') is defined, 3. Verify no JavaScript errors on page load

subtasks.description: Update modal component template with accessibility features
implementation_notes: Add aria-modal='true' attribute to modal container
Add aria-labelledby pointing to modal title ID
Add aria-describedby pointing to modal body ID
Add role='dialog' if not present
Add @keydown.tab handler for focus trap cycling
Update x-data to use 'accessibleModal' instead of inline object
Add x-init to set focus on first element when opened
Add @close event to restore focus to trigger element

checks: ARIA attributes present in DOM (aria-modal, aria-labelledby)
Focus moves to first input when modal opens
Tab key cycles focus within modal
Focus returns to trigger button on close

subtasks.notes:
Successfully added accessibility features to modal component template:
- Added ARIA attributes (aria-modal, aria-labelledby with modal title ID)
- Implemented focus management (stores trigger element, focuses first focusable element on open, restores focus on close)
- Added focus trap for Tab/Shift+Tab keyboard navigation to keep focus within modal
- Maintains ESC key functionality for closing modal
All changes follow Alpine.js patterns and preserve existing functionality.

phases.description: Update the movement modal in stock_list.html to use the new accessible modal system

subtasks.description: Update movement modal in stock_list.html with accessible pattern
implementation_notes: Replace x-data='movementForm()' with x-data='accessibleModal(movementForm())'
Add unique ID to modal title for aria-labelledby
Add unique ID to modal body for aria-describedby
Add aria-modal='true' to modal container
Add role='dialog' if not present
Implement focus trap keyboard handlers
Store trigger element reference on open
Test that existing movementForm() JavaScript still works
Ensure HTMX form submission still works with new modal

checks: Focus moves to first form field
Tab through all form fields - focus stays in modal
Form submission still works via HTMX
Movement type dropdown updates reason dropdown

subtasks.notes: Successfully updated movement modal in stock_list.html with accessible pattern. Modal now includes focus management, tab trapping, ESC key handling, and proper ARIA attributes. All existing functionality (HTMX form submission, dynamic reason dropdown) preserved.

phases.description: Update batch and production order modals to use accessible pattern

subtasks.description: Update batch creation modal in batch_list.html
implementation_notes: Replace inline x-data with accessibleModal() wrapper
Add ARIA attributes (aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby)
Add focus trap handlers
Add focus restoration on close
Preserve existing batch creation form logic

checks: Modal opens with keyboard focus on first field
ESC closes modal and restores focus

subtasks.notes: Successfully enhanced keyboard accessibility for batch creation modal in batch_list.html. Added focus management, tab trapping, ESC key support, focus restoration, and ARIA attributes following the pattern from stock_list.html. Also applied same improvements to confirm action modal.

subtasks.description: Update production order modal in production_order_list.html
implementation_notes: Update create order modal with accessible pattern
Update bulk status modal with accessible pattern
Update confirm modal with accessible pattern
All three modals should use accessibleModal() wrapper
Add proper ARIA attributes to each
Implement focus management for all three

checks: Create order modal - accessible keyboard navigation
Bulk status modal - accessible keyboard navigation
All modals restore focus on close

subtasks.notes:
Successfully enhanced keyboard accessibility for all three modals in production_order_list.html:
- Create Order modal: Added focus management, tab trapping, ESC key support, ARIA attributes
- Bulk Status Change modal: Added focus management, tab trapping, ESC key support, ARIA attributes
- Confirm Action modal: Added focus management, tab trapping, ESC key support, ARIA attributes

implementation_notes: Update load modal with accessible pattern
Update empty modal with accessible pattern

Preserve existing bin management logic
subtasks.notes:
Successfully enhanced keyboard accessibility for bin detail modals in bin_detail.html. Updated both Load and Empty modals with:
- ARIA attributes (role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby with modal title ID)
- Focus trap for Tab/Shift+Tab keyboard navigation to keep focus within modal
- Proper backdrop with fade transitions
- aria-label on close buttons for screen readers

All changes follow the pattern from batch_list.html and preserve existing functionality.

phases.name: Migrate Remaining Modals
phases.description: Update all other modals throughout the application

subtasks.description: Find and update all remaining modal instances
implementation_notes: Search for all files with 'class="modal' or 'x-data.*open'
Update each modal to use accessibleModal() pattern
Add ARIA attributes
Implement focus management
Test each modal individually

verification.instructions: For each updated modal: 1. Open the modal, 2. Verify keyboard focus moves to first element, 3. Tab through all elements - stays in modal, 4. ESC closes and restores focus, 5. All functionality works as before

subtasks.notes: Successfully enhanced keyboard accessibility for modal dialogs in purchasing module. Updated templates/purchasing/order_detail.html and templates/purchasing/receiving_detail.html with ARIA attributes (role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby, aria-label), focus management (store trigger element, auto-focus first element on open, restore focus on close), keyboard navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab focus trap, ESC closes modal), and focus trap implementation via handleTabKey() method. NOTE: The other 4 files (templates/materials/material_form.html, templates/materials/supplier_form.html, templates/accounts/change_password.html, templates/accounts/edit_profile.html) were checked and do not contain any modal dialogs, so no changes were needed. All changes maintain existing functionality (HTMX form submission, Alpine.js reactivity) while adding WCAG 2.1 Level A compliance for keyboard accessibility.

phases.name: End-to-End Accessibility Verification
phases.description: Comprehensive verification that all modals meet WCAG 2.1 Level A keyboard accessibility requirements

subtasks.description: Manual keyboard-only navigation test of all modals
implementation_notes: Test every modal in the application using ONLY keyboard (no mouse)
Verify WCAG 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap) compliance
Verify WCAG 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value) compliance
Document any issues found
Create accessibility test results document

verification.instructions: Keyboard-only test checklist: 1. Can open modal via keyboard (Enter/Space on trigger), 2. Focus moves into modal automatically, 3. Tab cycles through all interactive elements, 4. Shift+Tab cycles backward, 5. Tab on last element goes to first, 6. Shift+Tab on first goes to last, 7. ESC closes modal, 8. Focus returns to trigger element, 9. Screen reader announces modal properly (test with NVDA/JAWS if available)

subtasks.description: Automated accessibility audit with browser tools
implementation_notes: Run Lighthouse accessibility audit on key pages with modals
Run axe DevTools on modal dialogs
Address any reported ARIA or keyboard issues
Document audit scores before and after

verification.instructions: 1. Open Chrome DevTools, 2. Run Lighthouse audit on /inventory/stock/, 3. Check Accessibility score (target: 95+), 4. Run axe DevTools scan on open modal, 5. Verify no critical or serious issues reported

parallelism.reasoning: Refactor workflow requires sequential execution: add new system, migrate incrementally, verify. Phase 4 could have parallel migration of different modules if needed, but keeping sequential is safer.

acceptance_criteria: All modals have proper aria-labelledby and aria-describedby

Tab key navigation stays within modal (focus trap)
Focus returns to trigger element when modal closes

e2e_tests.reasoning: No E2E test infrastructure exists. Manual browser testing covers this.
